subject: Close timeline — legal gate working snapshot and owners
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Close timeline — legal gate working snapshot and owners

Hi Jane / Acme procurement team,

Following our Friday checkpoint I’m sending a compact working snapshot of the legal/procurement gates we discussed and owners for this week. I’ve included the current redlines and the draft order form for your review (see attachments). High-level: we’re tracking to the week-of-3/15 for production availability if the remaining items below close on time.

Outstanding items (current status):
- MSA redline review: Redwood legal has accepted most changes; ACME asked for edits in Sections 5 and 7. Owner: Aditya Rao (Redwood legal lead).
- Order form finalization: pricing and billing contact confirmed; need signature block + PO number. Owner: Priyom Das (sales operations).
- Vendor setup (GCP project + billing): requires vendor account name and W-9. Owner: Karthik Iyer (vendor ops).
- SOC2 / security evidence: we shared the evidence folder; procurement asked for log retention policy doc. Owner: Mina Haddad (security liaison).

Action items / due dates (please confirm if these are aligned with your procurement timeline):
- Aditya: provide a one-page summary of the final MSA exceptions and proposed compromise by 2026-03-04 EOD.
- Priyom: populate the order form with Acme PO number and return to me by 2026-03-05.
- Karthik: create vendor onboarding ticket in our portal and share the setup checklist; target 2026-03-06.
- Jane / Acme: confirm internal PO timing and whether a signed DocuSign or emailed PO is preferred; please reply with preference by 2026-03-04.

Meeting: I’ve scheduled a 30-minute sync for Thursday 2026-03-05 at 10:00 AM PT — calendar invite sent.

Attachments (stubs):
- ACME_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf (redlines + inline comments)
- OrderForm_ACME_v4.docx (pricing table, billing contact)
- vendor_setup_checklist.xlsx (required fields for vendor portal)

Thanks — short update from each of you will help keep the close date intact.

– Mina
Mina Haddad | Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Mina — that breakdown is helpful. A couple of quick notes from procurement:
- We can do DocuSign for the order form (preferred), but finance will still need a PO number issued before payment.
- Target for PO issuance is 2026-03-10 (internal processing), but if Aditya can limit outstanding MSA asks to a short list we can run an accelerated approval.

I’ll confirm whether we need the W-9 or other vendor tax docs today.

Quick update from legal: I reviewed the ACME redlines in ACME_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf. Summary:
- Section 5 (Data use) — we can accept the suggested wording with a single clarification; I added a short paragraph in the attached redline explaining the scope.
- Section 7 (Liability cap) — ACME is asking for a carveout that isn’t acceptable as drafted; proposed compromise included in my notes (see inline).
- Encryption / key management language — we’re OK to add the KMS integration line if Acme confirms they don’t require a unique HSM per project.

I’ve attached a 1-page summary (redline-summary-aditya.pdf) with the two remaining items that need ACME decision. If ACME can pick between options A/B for Section 7 by Thursday, we should be able to sign quickly.

Attachments referenced: redline-summary-aditya.pdf (summary + suggested compromises)

Aditya

Thanks all for the quick turns. Finalizing notes and next checkpoint: 
- Aditya: please send the 1-page summary and mark Section 7 options A/B clearly (due: 2026-03-05) — noted as received.
- Priyom: please confirm billing contact and whether you’ll accept DocuSign + emailed PO number (due: 2026-03-05) — Priyom, can you CC finance once you have the PO?
- Karthik: vendor ticket VEND-3482 created — please push the checklist to Acme and confirm when the W-9 arrives.
- Jane / Acme: if you can shortlist Section 7 option A or B by end of day Monday 2026-03-08 we’ll route for signature the same day.

I’m attaching the current files once more for visibility. If everyone is aligned I’ll close the loop after Monday and we’ll aim to get DocuSign routing started on 3/9.

Next sync: cancel the Thursday meeting if ACME chooses option by Monday; otherwise we’ll keep it.

Thanks —
